text: Judi Health (formerly Capital Rx, Inc.) is a private, venture-backed company; its September 2025 $400M investment (including a $252M Series F round) was led by Wellington Management and General Catalyst, with no state or state-fund investor identified.

source.name: Judi Health (formerly Capital Rx, Inc.): Capital Rx Announces Funding Round of $400M...
source.quote: The oversubscribed round, led by Wellington Management and General Catalyst, will be used to enhance and scale the Company's Enterprise Health Platform
